text: Hear all ye people: Heb. hear ye people all of them | all that therein is: Heb. the fullness thereof
a steep place: Heb. a descent
owls: Heb. daughters of the owl
her wound is incurable: Or, she is greviously sick of her wounds
inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress | Saphir: Or, thou that dwellest fairly | Zaanan: Or, the country of flocks | Bethezel: Or, a place near
to: Or, for | Achzib: That is, a lie
he shall come unto Adullam, the glory of Israel: Or, the glory of Israel shall come etc.
